coverage_note: Scanned entire target page 6 of TSM 1600. Extracted component mechanical seal installation procedure (steps 1-5 plus notes), O-ring and clamped-in seat installation sub-procedures, component mechanical seal removal procedure (steps 1-7), elastomeric/PTFE seal replacement requirement, Figure 8 note about P-80 lubrication, danger warnings for chamber opening and guard mounting, and discontinued model note. Previous page 5 context confirmed continuity of DANGER blocks and general structure but was not used as a source of new triples. All procedural steps, causal chains (particles→scratch→leakage), conditional requirements (sizes K-LS for half round rings), negative prohibitions (no grease, never touch seal faces), and safety prerequisites were represented. No troubleshooting table exists on this page.
